title: Employee Benefit Expert
full_description:
At ING we are looking for a Employee Benefit Expert
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for a highly experienced and rigorous professional to join our People / HR function in a critical role combining Employee Benefits, Flexible Compensation, Payroll, and Labor Relations.
This position requires deep technical expertise, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to challenge the status quo to continuously improve processes and employee experience.
Your key responsibilities:
As anEmployee Benefits Expertyou will:
Own the end-to-end management of employee benefits and flexible compensation programs, such as meal vouchers, transport, childcare, training, health insurance, company car, pension plans, savings and insurance products.
Ensure full understanding and correct application of benefit schemes, including eligibility rules, limits, and employee elections.
Assess and manage the tax, payroll, and Social Security impact of each benefit and flexible compensation component, translating benefit choices into correct payroll concepts: earnings, deductions, taxable and non‑taxable elements.
Ensure correct application of benefits and flexible compensation in payroll calculations.
Ensure compliance with Spanish labor, tax, and Social Security legislation.
Provide support on labor relations topics, collective agreements, employment benefits regulations and internal policies.
Act as subject-matter expert, advising HR, Finance, and employees on benefit-related matters.
Lead benefit audits and controls to ensure accuracy and regulatory compliance.
Ensure high data quality, governance, and reporting standards.
Drive improvements and simplification of benefit processes.
Manage and optimize benefit and payroll-related processes in Workday.
Ensure accurate data flow between benefits, payroll, taxation, and Social Security reporting.
Benefits vendor management (SLAs, day to day controls, contract management)
What are we looking for?
Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
Strong, hands-on experience in Employee Benefits and Flexible Compensation management (at least 5 years of experience).
Deep knowledge of Spanish labor law, tax regulations, and Social Security framework in relation employee benefits.
Proven experience integrating benefits and payroll processes.
Operational experience with Workday (benefits & compensation modules).
High level of English (working language; both written and spoken).
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and regulations.
Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity and critical thinking capability.
Continuous improvement mindset: always looking for better, simpler, and more efficient ways of working.
High level of flexibility and adaptability in a changing environment.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Must be a self-starter with the ability to work independently.
The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.
Check out what is waiting for you!
Be flexible my friend.
Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.
So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.
Our house will be your home.
In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!
For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).
We help you protect what matters most to you.
Flexible remuneration.
In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…
Free company shuttle.
It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.
Special loans with more beneficial conditions.
Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.
And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!
More vitality and more belonging
360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).
